annotations.title: Re-shoot a Clip from New Angles

description: Re-shoot one clip from NEW camera angles: same people, same words in the same timing, same place — only the camera changes, cutting on the spoken lines, as if several cameras had been rolling. This tool plans and checks; it never generates and never charges. Workflow: look at the clip with lab_bilder at exact seconds across its whole length (denser over fast moments), get the spoken lines with lab_wortzeiten, then ask the person ONE question — keep the original look, or a cinematic interpretation (then pick a kino_kopf from aktion optionen). Then call aktion plan with the shot list: every shot says WHERE the camera physically stands, neighbouring shots differ in size, the shots cover the clip without gaps, and original_kamera describes the original angle so the prompt can forbid it. The answer lists findings (hart = fix before anything costs) and the ready runs in stuecke[].lauf. With preis: true it also returns the price of all pieces and an estimate for upscaling afterwards — name it and wait for the yes. Then pass each stuecke[].lauf UNCHANGED to lab_reference_motion, in order. Every run is a low-resolution draft where the model offers one; upscale only what the person likes (lab_upscale). Clips longer than the chosen model can take are split at shot boundaries into several runs (zusammensetzen: true) — for more than a handful of runs propose one lab_auto_lauf with a cap. When all pieces are finished, aktion zusammensetzen puts them into ONE new sequence without gaps, each piece with its original sound. If a result comes back wrong, ONE retry: original angle came back → shorter shot list, describe the original angle more physically, make the first shot radically different (profile or top-down); timing drifted → put the spoken line in quotes on its shot; left and right swapped → describe positions by landmarks, not screen directions; people changed → add a clean still as an image with the job of how the person looks.

aktion.description: optionen: models with their limits, shot sizes, cinematic headers (free, no project needed). plan (default): check the shot list and build the runs. zusammensetzen: finished pieces into one new sequence

bild_urls.description: Image addresses for plan.bilder, same order

laengen_s.description: zusammensetzen: the planned length of each piece (stuecke[].bis_s - von_s), same order

name.description: zusammensetzen: title of the new sequence

anfang_behalten.description: The first shot stays identical to the original

bilder.description: One job per extra reference image, e.g. 'how the woman looks'. Same order as bild_urls

dauer_s.description: Length of the clip in seconds

einstellungen.description: The shot list, in order, covering the clip without gaps

bild.description: Optional: one short sentence on what we see

groesse.description: Shot size key from aktion optionen

kamera_ort.description: Where the camera physically stands in ONE sentence — side, height, distance, by landmarks

zeile.description: The words spoken during this shot, verbatim — the cut lands on them

kino_kopf.description: Cinematic header key from aktion optionen

look.description: gleich: keep the original look. kino: re-shoot it like a film (needs kino_kopf)

original_kamera.description: The ORIGINAL angle in physical words: where the camera stands, its height, what it points at. The prompt forbids exactly this

personen.description: Who is in the clip, half a sentence — for naming only, no character paragraphs

preis.description: Also price all pieces (free, books nothing)

project_id.description: Project — required for plan and zusammensetzen

rechte_bestaetigt.description: The person confirmed they hold the rights to an uploaded clip — passed into every run

reference_video_url.description: The clip to re-shoot: an uploaded file (lab_add_media / lab_list_assets) or a finished clip of this project

tool.description: Model key from aktion optionen (only models that take a clip as reference). Default: the first one listed there

video_ids.description: zusammensetzen: the finished pieces, in order
